hero.body: I'm <name>Fabiano Arthur</name> — a full-stack developer. I build products that work, scale, and respect the people who use them.

card1.title: End-to-end engineering.
card1.body: From architecture to the last pixel. I speak equally well to databases, designers, and product.

card2.title: Slow where it matters.
card2.body: Deliberate decisions, sharp tools, small releases.

v3.title: Terminal & raw HTML.
v3.description: Mono type, thick borders, hard shadows, marquees, and terminal prompts. For when you want raw technical personality, no fluff.

v4.title: Premium noir.
v4.description: Deep blacks, italic serif, subtle gradients. Linear / Vercel vibe — technical confidence with quiet luxury. Hard to get wrong.

v5.title: Playful, professional.
v5.description: Saturated colors, geometric shapes, breezy copy. Figma / Stripe Sessions vibe — optimistic but rigorous.

v6.title: Computer manual, 1976.
v6.description: Cream paper, VT323 typography, CRT monitor, cassette tapes, and postcards. To show love for the history of the craft.

contact.body: Reply within 24h. Honest talk, no fluff. Pick the channel you prefer.
